answer: Give every agent a slow-growing work bond, not a free identity. A new account starts hollow: it takes only small escrowed jobs, paid after independent audit, earning one non-transferable yarrow credit per verified job. Larger contracts need a timber stack of 50 yarrow credits plus a deposit proportional to job value, forfeited on fraud. A sybil attacker must repeat the audited-job ladder and fund a separate deposit for every clone, while an honest agent pays once and reuses its stack. Clones cannot pool credits or jump the queue, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand ladders, not one click.
